cargo xtask ci-helper portal-release-smoke --base-url http://localhost:8081 --expected-theme darker

parity: Landing page requires HTTP 200, the search form, exact configured theme, and CSP.
Healthz requires HTTP 200 and trimmed body OK.
Search uses the empty __portal_smoke__ category, accepts HTTP 200 or 503, and requires JSON query preservation and a results array.
Query parameters are encoded; probe order and Accept headers match the predecessor.
intentional_improvements: Declared bodies over 1 MiB are rejected before reading; unknown-length streams are rejected before body accumulation would exceed 1 MiB.
Each probe, including its redirect chain, shares one 30-second deadline; response headers are limited to 64 KiB and at most ten HTTP(S) redirects are followed.
Curl's default configuration is disabled. Loopback targets bypass proxies; non-loopback targets use the caller's proxy environment.

The URL is supplied to curl over stdin rather than command-line arguments. Base URL credentials, query, and fragment are rejected; redirect credentials are also rejected; diagnostics omit URLs, query text, headers, and response bodies.
Responses are not decompressed, matching urllib's raw-byte behavior before UTF-8 replacement decoding.
non_goals: No image is built, pushed, promoted, deployed, or rolled back by this helper.
The Python source and frozen historical invocation/disposition inventories are not deleted or rewritten.
This is not full O02 acceptance; cargo xtask check O02 remains unimplemented and the other O02 workflow tools remain in scope.
